# Isolated private authentication trial

This entry point is only for `bee-validation-20260909`. Production source and configuration are unchanged.

The hosted CLI and broker have passed a private, single-use runtime test. That evidence does not establish an approved user's grant or successful retrieval.

During the next trial, homepage, static assets, unknown paths and the unconfigured GitHub route remain unavailable even when the validation window is active. `/authorize` redirects with an empty body to the existing email Access route and preserves the complete OAuth query. Only exact protocol paths and methods pass through; malformed HTML error pages are not published. MCP, client registration, token exchange and OAuth discovery remain outside Access interstitials. Consent and pairing retain their existing signed-state and identity allow-list checks.

No email identity is admitted by this source change. An explicitly approved private test identity must be installed entirely within trusted tooling before the email trial is activated. Test signing/admission values, inbox codes, pairing URLs, QR contents and grants must not enter chat, model context, Git or journals.

The former diagnostic probe route, methods and secret controls are removed from this module. Current bindings contain no diagnostic secret or active validation window. Historical inactive versions are retained and are not described as erased.

Remaining acceptance includes actual inbox OTP, user Bee approval, own-grant MCP retrieval, two-user grant/data isolation, logging/privacy checks and independent validation. Exact public-copy approval and separately authorized production promotion remain later gates.
